# appstoreconnect_app (Data Source)

Looks up an app in App Store Connect by its bundle identifier.

The lookup fails unless exactly one app visible to the API key has that bundle identifier.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appstoreconnect_app" "example" {
  bundle_id = "com.example.app"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bundle_id` (String) The bundle identifier of the app, e.g. `com.example.app`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `name` (String) The name of the app.
- `primary_locale` (String) The primary locale of the app, e.g. `en-US`.
- `sku` (String) The SKU of the app.
